single_authority.mode: configured() / RuntimeClient fence only; determine before loading legacy env. No context => legacy; invalid context != absent. Never infer mode or caller ID from cwd/project/name/tmux/child CLI flags.
single_authority.identity: context.identity stable ID/generation and fixed credential.json are sole mutable owner state. Child manifest references context; no token/name/project/window copies. Name is refreshed display only. Per-operation binding snapshot is immutable evidence, not a second authority.
single_authority.mutation: one fixed runtime/mutation-pending.json + binding-independent mutex for S2a/S2b/S2c write operations; family-specific format discriminator allowed, no simultaneous journals for same mutation. Raw message intent is the sole resend source; semantic hash derived, not saved as another payload.
single_authority.lifecycle: one fixed runtime/child-state.json for provider/task/tools/parent IDs/history reference/retention/lifecycle phase. No name-keyed child JSON or raw-token mirror in global. Registration pending is existing 4a slot, not copied into lifecycle. Each lifecycle stage only refers to one current mutation request ID if needed.
single_authority.scope: work folder/vault destination remains filesystem metadata, never Mail scope. Shell arguments are typed JSON through helper stdin, not ad-hoc key=value serialization for arrays/null/booleans.
single_authority.database: no DB file paths in child API and no SQLite opens/raw reads/copies/hashes in client process. Global dashboard resume bypasses legacy DB/cache branches.
single_authority.dispatch: bin/lib/agentstack-register.sh remains the sole shell mode dispatch for registration/child operations. Existing source callers invoke its functions. Dashboard calls its executable JSON operation entrypoint, not a second Python adapter. Only its global branch delegates to existing RuntimeClient operations; legacy internals stay as legacy implementation, not dual writes. RuntimeClient remains lower-level owner/schema/HTTP authority.

fixed_layout.root: <isolation>/agentstack/clients/<client_name>, existing lowercase safe-name rule; root siblings disjoint, new identity=new root
fixed_layout.retained: existing CLIENT_LAYOUT plus runtime/child-state.json, runtime/child.lock, runtime/task.md and runtime/release-debounce.json; session evidence in runtime/live-sessions/; provider outputs deferred4c
fixed_layout.no_arbitrary_output: global rejects --token-file-out/--child-token-file/--profile arbitrary destinations. Task source is read-only input snapshotted to fixed task.md. Generated provider config never authorizes independent token file.
fixed_layout.preflight: all fixed slots registered in one RuntimeClient output_plan before network/write, type+private mode+owner+nlink checks; no recursive ownership scan. Helpers share schema and allowed slot registry.
fixed_layout.lifecycle_lock: binding-independent private lock with fixed magic; child helper and dashboard use same operation lock, no per-entrypoint lock implementations. Lock order child lock → authority shared fence → mutation mutex (no inverse acquisition). The fixed operation mutex applies to standalone identity roots too, without requiring child-state.json; live SessionStart/resume/end share it.
fixed_layout.retention: fixed generated provider artifacts can be regenerated. Provider transcript is retained source within fixed provider home; no backup copy. credential persists for resume; explicit forget/purge credential is operator-only.

preregister.retry: Repeat the same --context and --child-client-name --prepare-only invocation. Existing registration pending supplies immutable name/token/metadata/binding; caller cannot overwrite it with changed arguments. Registration recovery is this same entrypoint, not a second resume adapter.

spawn.explicit_context: parent entrypoint context required; child config derived fixed sibling root; missing/ambiguous reference is an error
spawn.normal_execution: default launch requires 4c capability before registration or mutation; 4b prepare-only never creates tmux/LLM

resume.history: provider session ID from verified self session record, immutable Mail ID from context; never infer from latest rollout/mtime/name

local_cli_contract.input_schema: CLI argument parsing and local JSON schemas proposed here; names/flags provisional until review. Server schemas unchanged, inherited by fixture references.

server_dispatch_contract.catalog: compile union of S1 + S2a + S2b + S2c from their exact fixtures. Capability-gated only; absent => CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE. shared schema validator + assemble_rejections; no parallel classifier.
server_dispatch_contract.registration: Reuse existing create/finalize/activate order and S1 input limits. Once registration pending is saved, same name/token/metadata/binding only; NAME_CONFLICT keeps pending through parent resolve and child owner verification. Candidate name selection is before that saved intent, never an automatic retry under a new name.
server_dispatch_contract.metadata: resume/reconnect no explicit program/model => refresh/touch. Explicit provider metadata uses saved values, no codex/codex default overwrite. No auto policy writes.
server_dispatch_contract.mutation: S2a/S2c canonical arguments via common schema helper; S2b uses existing make_intent/resume_intent/complete_intent moved to pure shared module. Preserve server byte/hash acceptance; JSON typed CLI prevents split/quote errors.
server_dispatch_contract.peer: resolve names at initial explicit intent only, save stable target IDs. Retry does not resolve names again; parent rename does not redirect report.
server_dispatch_contract.read: fetch pure read does not clear signals. Hooks/reminder do not poll inbox merely to register. await/wake runtime remains4c. Reading result does not imply read/ack.
server_dispatch_contract.response: all output schemas plus current binding/owner/request ID and semantic identity fields validated before clearing pending. Never reuse contact-only S2a output assumptions for leases/messages.
server_dispatch_contract.refusal: schema_contract.assemble_rejections(S2c) + definitive_rejection only. Existing pending auth/fence/unknown/request-ID conflict preserved. Known definite domain rejection clears only same saved bytes under mutex.
server_dispatch_contract.retire: retire_agent owns ACTIVE release in same server transaction; no extra release in child cleanup. Repeated lifecycle request may update timestamps/revision (S1 is not receipt-idempotent); current target status check avoids blind repeat. retired authentication via same-UID inspect+fingerprint before unretire, then whois.

reservation_hook_contract.pre_edit: Replay a pending renew with the same UUID before check. Read coverage and own ACTIVE expiry; renew only with remaining TTL <= client RENEW_THRESHOLD_SECONDS (600), new TTL1800. No receipt below threshold.
reservation_hook_contract.post_edit: captured owned lease IDs and hook local generation; grace worker rechecks exact context/binding/owner and current generation. Stale worker never releases newer lease IDs. Duplicate completion/no match is success no-op.
reservation_hook_contract.session_end: 共通end判定へ。別session live/unknownは全件release無し。最後のchildはretireのみ。最後のstandaloneのみ自己ACTIVEをkeysetで<=100ID batch release。詳細end_contract。
reservation_hook_contract.outage: Q4=B決定。既存session-identity-policy.shの既定warn-open/明示warn-open/明示blockを共用。初期transport outageに限り編集を許可して同じ警告/監査、その他の既存拒否を維持。refuseは説明上の呼称、実設定値はblock。
reservation_hook_contract.renew_recovery: Next PreToolUse replays the saved renew intent with the same UUID before a new check. Unknown/auth/binding/schema outcomes preserve pending and refuse editing.

registration_retry_contract.sole_pending: existing credential.registration-pending.json; same name/token/program/model/task/binding replay. No second registration journal, new token/name, or server tool.
sequence: validate fixed context/pending and shared child lock
retry S1 register(new) with identical saved values
if success validate row and activate through existing4a finalize order
only NAME_CONFLICT: authenticated parent resolve_agent_identity(saved name) → child token whois(candidate ID) → validate exact binding/generation/fingerprint → activate same ID
registration_retry_contract.existing_create_change: do not delete child pending on NAME_CONFLICT before owner check. Definitive NAME_INVALID has no retry value and reports invalid input; never silently chooses a different name for an existing pending.
registration_retry_contract.communication_failure: retain same pending and retry same intent after transport restoration. Parent unavailable/resolve unavailable is not proof another owner claimed the name. No routine operator abandon/new root for row-less/unknown.
registration_retry_contract.foreign_owner: only a definite child owner credential rejection after resolving the conflicting ID goes to minimal explicit operator inspection/abandon. Wrong binding/schema/network remains unknown, not foreign owner.
registration_retry_contract.exception_exit: operator compares expected pending SHA256 under same child lock, acknowledges conflicting ownership, marks that same pending terminal without deleting credential evidence; current root cannot register/launch again. New identity requires explicit new root. Separate export/backup copy is not made. Never retire the foreign ID.
registration_retry_contract.late_activation: same root helper serializes whole register→activation with child lock; before every output verifies current pending. Terminal exception blocks ordinary create/finalize. Late remote outcome remains observation; operator exception is not rollback.
registration_retry_contract.namespace_boundary: repeat safety relies on same name remaining the registration key while intent unresolved; concurrent external rename/delete is not covered as unconditional idempotence. Such operator mutation must preserve/reconcile pending, not cause automatic re-registration under a new key.

end_contract.one_entry: register.sh end operation, shared by release-all SessionEnd and cleanup; global SessionStart/resume use same local operation lock. Liveness implementation is shared, not duplicated in hook.
end_contract.identity: stable ID+current context, current session_id/pane_id/launch_id excluded only after verifying same binding. name and PID alone do not prove ownership; pre-boot PID is not current evidence.
rows: release self ACTIVE in keyset<=100-ID batches
delegate to same end; no separate release
retire once and let S2c release ACTIVE
end_contract.race: liveness enter/end is serialized in same local mutex; never hold inverse lock order. Unknown external process/session evidence is kept as unknown. Session liveness records are execution evidence, not new lease ownership state.
end_contract.cleanup_repeat: inspect before retrying non-receipt retire; target already retired means preserve retained state and finish local bookkeeping, do not re-stamp retirement blindly.
end_contract.standalone_batch: list own ACTIVE keyset at frozen max ID; exact<=100IDs per existing mutation intent. New reservations after page0 excluded. No new session lease table.
end_contract.legacy: existing legacy end chain unchanged; its unconditional SessionEnd release is a known separate limitation, not fixed by global-only dispatch.
